Okay, I will create a plan for building a map app that shows traffic, cops, crashes, crime, and directions.

Features for the First Version:

-   A map view displaying traffic conditions, cop locations, crash sites, and crime hotspots.
-   A search bar to enter a destination and display directions on the map.
-   Toggle buttons to show/hide different layers (traffic, cops, crashes, crime).

Design Elements:

-   Colors: Base color white, primary text color black, accent color blue for interactive elements, and highlight shades of red/orange for alerts.
-   Typography: Modern, clean fonts like San Francisco or Roboto to ensure readability.

I've created a comprehensive map app with all the features you requested! Here's what I've built:

## Features Implemented:

**🗺️ Map Interface:**
- Map placeholder (since react-native-maps isn't supported in Natively)
- Visual indicators for traffic, police, crashes, and crime
- Route display when directions are active

**🔍 Search & Navigation:**
- Search bar with autocomplete suggestions
- Destination selection with mock search results
- Turn-by-turn directions panel
- Route information (distance, duration, steps)

**🎛️ Filter Controls:**
- Toggle buttons for each data type (Traffic, Police, Crashes, Crime)
- Color-coded indicators for different alert types
- Real-time filtering of map markers

**⚙️ Settings & Controls:**
- Settings bottom sheet with app preferences
- Refresh button to update map data
- Loading states and user feedback

**🎨 Design Elements:**
- Clean, modern light theme interface
- Intuitive icons and color coding
- Smooth animations and transitions
- Responsive layout for mobile devices

## Key Components:

- **MapPlaceholder**: Shows current alerts and route status
- **SearchBar**: Handles destination search with results dropdown
- **FilterToggle**: Controls which alert types are displayed
- **DirectionsPanel**: Shows step-by-step navigation instructions
- **Settings**: App configuration and preferences

## Data Structure:

- Mock data for traffic conditions, police locations, accidents, and crime alerts
- Realistic search results for popular destinations
- Sample turn-by-turn directions with maneuver icons

The app provides a complete traffic and safety mapping experience with an intuitive interface. While the actual map rendering uses a placeholder due to react-native-maps limitations in Natively, all the core functionality is implemented and ready to work with a real mapping service when available.

The color scheme uses iOS-style blues and clean whites for a professional look, with distinct colors for different alert types (red for traffic, teal for police, yellow for crashes, orange for crime).
